    ].join('\n');

    var style = document.createElement('style');
    style.id = 'trtt-pro-css';
    style.textContent = css;
    document.head.appendChild(style);

  function updateModeButton(btn) {
    if (!btn) return;
    var night = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-trtt-mode') === 'night';
    btn.textContent = '';
    btn.appendChild(makeIcon(night ? 'sun' : 'moon', 14));
    btn.appendChild(document.createTextNode(night ? ' Day Mode' : ' Night Mode'));
    btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', night ? 'true' : 'false');
  }

  function setupTopStripAndLogo() {
    var header = document.querySelector('.trtt-header');
    if (!header) return;

    if (document.getElementById('tu-bub') || document.getElementById('trtt-menu-launch')) {
      document.body.classList.add('trtt-has-float');
    }

    if (!document.getElementById('trtt-top-strip')) {
      var strip = el('div', 'trtt-top-strip');
      strip.id = 'trtt-top-strip';
      var inner = el('div', 'trtt-shell trtt-top-strip-inner');
      var left = el('div', 'trtt-strip-left');
      var pill = el('span', 'trtt-strip-pill');
      pill.appendChild(el('span', 'trtt-strip-dot'));
      pill.appendChild(document.createTextNode('TRTT NEWS 24 BD'));
      left.appendChild(pill);

      var now = new Date();
      var dateText = '';
      try {
        dateText = now.toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { weekday: 'short', day: 'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' });
      } catch (e) {
        dateText = now.toDateString();
      }
      left.appendChild(el('span', 'trtt-strip-date', dateText + ' - Sanluri, Italy'));

      var right = el('div', 'trtt-strip-right');
      var modeBtn = el('button', 'trtt-pro-mode-btn');
      modeBtn.id = 'trtt-pro-mode-btn';
      modeBtn.type = 'button';
      updateModeButton(modeBtn);
      modeBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var root = document.documentElement;
        var next = root.getAttribute('data-trtt-mode') === 'night' ? 'day' : 'night';
        root.setAttribute('data-trtt-mode', next);
        try { window.localStorage.setItem('trtt-mode-choice', next); } catch (e) {}
        updateModeButton(modeBtn);
      });
      right.appendChild(modeBtn);

      inner.appendChild(left);
      inner.appendChild(right);
      strip.appendChild(inner);
      header.parentNode.insertBefore(strip, header);

      if (window.MutationObserver) {
        new MutationObserver(function () {
          updateModeButton(modeBtn);
        }).observe(document.documentElement, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['data-trtt-mode'] });
      }
    }

    var logoSlot = document.querySelector('.trtt-logo-slot');
    if (logoSlot && !logoSlot.querySelector('img') && !logoSlot.querySelector('.trtt-svg-logo')) {
      var link = el('a', 'trtt-svg-logo');
      link.href = HOME;
      link.setAttribute('aria-label', 'TRTT Voyage Home');

      var svg = svgEl('svg', { class: 'trtt-logo-mark', viewBox: '0 0 64 64', role: 'img', 'aria-label': 'TRTT Emblem' });
      var defs = svgEl('defs');
      var grad = svgEl('linearGradient', { id: 'trttLogoGrad', x1: '0%', y1: '0%', x2: '100%', y2: '100%' });
      grad.appendChild(svgEl('stop', { offset: '0%', 'stop-color': '#0284c7' }));
      grad.appendChild(svgEl('stop', { offset: '60%', 'stop-color': '#1d4ed8' }));
      grad.appendChild(svgEl('stop', { offset: '100%', 'stop-color': '#0f172a' }));
      defs.appendChild(grad);
      svg.appendChild(defs);
      svg.appendChild(svgEl('rect', { x: 0, y: 0, width: 64, height: 64, rx: 16, fill: 'url(#trttLogoGrad)' }));
      svg.appendChild(svgEl('circle', { cx: 32, cy: 32, r: 19, fill: 'none', stroke: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.28)', 'stroke-width': '1.8' }));
      svg.appendChild(svgEl('ellipse', { cx: 32, cy: 32, rx: 9, ry: 19, fill: 'none', stroke: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.24)', 'stroke-width': '1.5' }));
      svg.appendChild(svgEl('path', { d: 'M14 37 Q32 22 50 24', fill: 'none', stroke: '#fbbf24', 'stroke-width': '2.6', 'stroke-linecap': 'round' }));
      svg.appendChild(svgEl('path', { d: 'M43 19 L52 24 L45 29 L46 24 Z', fill: '#fbbf24' }));
      link.appendChild(svg);

      var textWrap = el('div', 'trtt-logo-text');
      var name = el('span', 'trtt-logo-name');
      name.appendChild(document.createTextNode('TRTT '));
      name.appendChild(el('span', '', 'VOYAGE'));
      textWrap.appendChild(name);
      textWrap.appendChild(el('span', 'trtt-logo-sub', 'SANLURI TO WORLD'));
      link.appendChild(textWrap);
      logoSlot.appendChild(link);

    var searchInput = document.querySelector('.trtt-search input[type="search"]');
    if (searchInput && !searchInput.getAttribute('placeholder')) {
      searchInput.setAttribute('placeholder', 'Search flights, eSIM, stories...');
    }

  function setupCategoryNav() {
    var header = document.querySelector('.trtt-header');
    if (!header || document.getElementById('trtt-pro-nav')) return;

    var nav = el('nav', 'trtt-pro-nav');
    nav.id = 'trtt-pro-nav';
    nav.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Main blog categories');

    var shell = el('div', 'trtt-shell');
    var list = el('ul', 'trtt-pro-nav-list');
    var currentUrl = decodeURIComponent(window.location.pathname).toLowerCase();

    var homeLi = el('li');
    var homeA = el('a', 'trtt-pro-nav-link' + (currentUrl === '/' || currentUrl === '' ? ' is-active' : ''), 'Home');
    homeA.href = HOME;
    homeLi.appendChild(homeA);
    list.appendChild(homeLi);

    CORE_LABELS.forEach(function (item) {
      var li = el('li');
      var active = currentUrl.indexOf('/search/label/' + item.label.toLowerCase()) !== -1;
      var a = el('a', 'trtt-pro-nav-link' + (active ? ' is-active' : ''));
      a.href = HOME + 'search/label/' + encodeURIComponent(item.label);
      var dot = el('span', 'trtt-nav-dot');
      dot.style.background = item.color;
      a.appendChild(dot);
      a.appendChild(document.createTextNode(item.name));
      li.appendChild(a);
      list.appendChild(li);
    });

    shell.appendChild(list);
    nav.appendChild(shell);
    header.parentNode.insertBefore(nav, header.nextSibling);
  }

  function renderLabelBadgesInPosts() {
    var itemTools = document.querySelector('.trtt-post-tools');
    var posts = document.querySelectorAll('.post-outer, .post');
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(posts, function (post) {
      if (post.getAttribute('data-trtt-labeled')) return;
      var seen = {};
      var labels = [];

      Array.prototype.forEach.call(post.querySelectorAll('.post-labels a, a[rel="tag"]'), function (a) {
        var name = (a.textContent || '').trim();
        if (name && !seen[name.toLowerCase()]) {
          seen[name.toLowerCase()] = true;
          labels.push({ name: name, href: a.href });
        }
      });

      if (!labels.length && itemTools) {
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(itemTools.querySelectorAll('.trtt-post-label'), function (span) {
          var name = (span.getAttribute('data-label') || '').trim();
          if (name && !seen[name.toLowerCase()]) {
            seen[name.toLowerCase()] = true;
            labels.push({ name: name, href: HOME + 'search/label/' + encodeURIComponent(name) });
          }
        });
      }

      if (!labels.length) return;
      var titleEl = post.querySelector('.post-title, .entry-title');
      if (!titleEl) return;

      var bar = el('div', 'trtt-label-pills');
      labels.slice(0, 5).forEach(function (lbl) {
        var st = labelStyle(lbl.name);
        var pill = el('a', 'trtt-label-pill');
        pill.href = lbl.href;
        pill.style.color = st.color;
        pill.style.background = st.bg;
        pill.style.borderColor = st.bg;
        pill.appendChild(makeIcon('tag', 11));
        pill.appendChild(document.createTextNode(lbl.name));
        bar.appendChild(pill);
      });

      titleEl.parentNode.insertBefore(bar, titleEl);
      post.setAttribute('data-trtt-labeled', '1');
    });

    Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.jump-link a'), function (btn) {
      if (!btn.classList.contains('trtt-jump-btn')) {
        btn.classList.add('trtt-jump-btn');
        btn.textContent = 'Read Full Story ->';
      }
    });
  }

  function enhanceSinglePost() {
    var body = document.querySelector('.post-body');
    var isSingle = document.querySelector('.trtt-post-tools') || document.body.className.indexOf('item') !== -1 || /\/\d{4}\/\d{2}\//.test(window.location.pathname);
    if (!body || !isSingle) return;

    var progress = document.getElementById('trtt-read-progress');
    if (!progress) {
      progress = el('div');
      progress.id = 'trtt-read-progress';
      document.body.appendChild(progress);
      window.addEventListener('scroll', function () {
        var h = document.documentElement;
        var total = h.scrollHeight - h.clientHeight;
        var pct = total > 0 ? Math.min(100, Math.max(0, (window.scrollY / total) * 100)) : 0;
        progress.style.width = pct.toFixed(1) + '%';
      }, { passive: true });
    }

    var postTitle = document.querySelector('.post-title, .entry-title');
    if (postTitle && !document.getElementById('trtt-post-meta-bar')) {
      var words = (body.textContent || '').trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;
      var mins = Math.max(1, Math.round(words / 210));
      var metaBar = el('div', 'trtt-post-meta-bar');
      metaBar.id = 'trtt-post-meta-bar';

      var stats = el('div', 'trtt-meta-stats');
      var timeStat = el('span', 'trtt-meta-stat');
      timeStat.appendChild(makeIcon('clock', 14));
      timeStat.appendChild(document.createTextNode(mins + ' min read (' + words + ' words)'));
      stats.appendChild(timeStat);
      stats.appendChild(el('span', '', 'By Abu Taher'));
      metaBar.appendChild(stats);

      var shareRow = el('div', 'trtt-share-row');
      var pageUrl = encodeURIComponent(window.location.href);
      var pageTitle = encodeURIComponent(document.title);

      var copyBtn = el('button', 'trtt-share-btn');
      copyBtn.type = 'button';
      copyBtn.appendChild(makeIcon('copy', 13));
      copyBtn.appendChild(document.createTextNode('Copy Link'));
      copyBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
          navigator.clipboard.writeText(window.location.href).then(function () {
            copyBtn.textContent = '';
            copyBtn.appendChild(makeIcon('check', 13));
            copyBtn.appendChild(document.createTextNode('Copied'));
            setTimeout(function () {
              copyBtn.textContent = '';
              copyBtn.appendChild(makeIcon('copy', 13));
              copyBtn.appendChild(document.createTextNode('Copy Link'));
            }, 2200);
          }).catch(function () {});
        }
      });
      shareRow.appendChild(copyBtn);

      var waLink = el('a', 'trtt-share-btn');
      waLink.href = 'https://wa.me/?text=' + pageTitle + '%20' + pageUrl;
      waLink.target = '_blank';
      waLink.rel = 'noopener noreferrer';
      waLink.appendChild(makeIcon('share', 13));
      waLink.appendChild(document.createTextNode('WhatsApp'));
      shareRow.appendChild(waLink);

      var fbLink = el('a', 'trtt-share-btn', 'Facebook');
      fbLink.href = 'https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=' + pageUrl;
      fbLink.target = '_blank';
      fbLink.rel = 'noopener noreferrer';
      shareRow.appendChild(fbLink);

      metaBar.appendChild(shareRow);
      postTitle.parentNode.insertBefore(metaBar, postTitle.nextSibling);
    }

    Array.prototype.forEach.call(body.querySelectorAll('table'), function (tbl) {
      if (tbl.parentNode && !tbl.parentNode.classList.contains('trtt-table-wrap')) {
        var wrap = el('div', 'trtt-table-wrap');
        tbl.parentNode.insertBefore(wrap, tbl);
        wrap.appendChild(tbl);
      }
    });

    if (!document.getElementById('trtt-img-zoom')) {
      var zoom = el('div');
      zoom.id = 'trtt-img-zoom';
      zoom.setAttribute('role', 'dialog');
      zoom.setAttribute('aria-modal', 'true');
      zoom.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Image preview');
      var zoomClose = el('button', '', 'x');
      zoomClose.id = 'trtt-img-zoom-close';
      zoomClose.type = 'button';
      zoomClose.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Close image preview');
      var zoomImg = document.createElement('img');
      zoomImg.alt = '';
      zoom.appendChild(zoomClose);
      zoom.appendChild(zoomImg);
      document.body.appendChild(zoom);

      function closeZoom() {
        zoom.classList.remove('open');
        zoomImg.src = '';
      }
      zoom.addEventListener('click', closeZoom);
      zoomClose.addEventListener('click', closeZoom);
      document.addEventListener('keydown', function (ev) {
        if (ev.key === 'Escape' && zoom.classList.contains('open')) closeZoom();
      });

      Array.prototype.forEach.call(body.querySelectorAll('img'), function (img) {
        img.addEventListener('click', function (ev) {
          if (img.closest && img.closest('a')) return;
          ev.preventDefault();
          zoomImg.src = img.src;
          zoomImg.alt = img.alt || 'TRTT Voyage Image';
          zoom.classList.add('open');
        });
      });
    }

    if (!document.getElementById('trtt-author-box')) {
      var author = el('section', 'trtt-author-box');
      author.id = 'trtt-author-box';
      author.appendChild(el('div', 'trtt-author-avatar', 'AT'));
      var info = el('div', 'trtt-author-info');
      info.appendChild(el('h4', '', 'Written by Abu Taher - TRTT News 24 BD'));
      info.appendChild(el('p', '', 'Independent travel publisher in Sanluri, Sardinia, Italy. Sharing honest flight guides, EC261 passenger rights, eSIM tips, and daily voyage notes.'));
      author.appendChild(info);

      var disclosure = body.querySelector('.trtt-disclosure');
      if (disclosure) body.insertBefore(author, disclosure);
      else body.appendChild(author);
    }
  }

  function loadLiveLabelsDirectory() {
    var sidebar = document.querySelector('.trtt-sidebar');
    if (!sidebar || document.getElementById('trtt-pro-labels-widget')) return;

    var widget = el('div', 'widget trtt-pro-labels-box');
    widget.id = 'trtt-pro-labels-widget';
    widget.appendChild(el('h2', '', 'All Blog Topics & Labels'));

    var search = el('input', 'trtt-pro-label-search');
    search.type = 'search';
    search.placeholder = 'Filter labels...';
    search.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Filter blog labels');
    widget.appendChild(search);

    var grid = el('div', 'trtt-pro-labels-grid');
    grid.appendChild(el('span', 'sm', 'Loading labels...'));
    widget.appendChild(grid);

    var firstWidget = sidebar.querySelector('.widget');
    if (firstWidget && firstWidget.nextSibling) {
      sidebar.insertBefore(widget, firstWidget.nextSibling);
    } else {
      sidebar.appendChild(widget);
    }

    var url = HOME.replace(/\/$/, '') + '/feeds/posts/summary?alt=json&max-results=150';
    fetch(url, { credentials: 'same-origin' }).then(function (r) {
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error('Feed error');
      return r.json();
    }).then(function (data) {
      var counts = {};
      var entries = data && data.feed && data.feed.entry ? data.feed.entry : [];
      entries.forEach(function (entry) {
        (entry.category || []).forEach(function (cat) {
          var term = (cat && cat.term ? cat.term : '').trim();
          if (term) counts[term] = (counts[term] || 0) + 1;
        });
      });

      var categories = data && data.feed && data.feed.category ? data.feed.category : [];
      categories.forEach(function (cat) {
        var term = (cat && cat.term ? cat.term : '').trim();
        if (term && !counts[term]) counts[term] = 1;
      });

      var list = Object.keys(counts).sort(function (a, b) {
        return counts[b] - counts[a] || a.localeCompare(b);
      });

      function render(filterText) {
        var q = String(filterText || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        grid.textContent = '';
        var shown = 0;
        list.forEach(function (name) {
          if (q && name.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) === -1) return;
          shown++;
          var st = labelStyle(name);
          var chip = el('a', 'trtt-pro-label-chip');
          chip.href = HOME + 'search/label/' + encodeURIComponent(name);
          chip.style.borderLeft = '3px solid ' + st.color;
          chip.appendChild(document.createTextNode(name));
          chip.appendChild(el('span', 'trtt-pro-label-count', String(counts[name])));
          grid.appendChild(chip);
        });
        if (!shown) {
          grid.appendChild(el('span', 'sm', 'No matching labels found.'));
        }
      }

      if (!list.length) {
        CORE_LABELS.forEach(function (c) { counts[c.label] = 1; });
        list = CORE_LABELS.map(function (c) { return c.label; });
      }
      render('');
      search.addEventListener('input', function () {
        render(search.value);
      });
    }).catch(function () {
      grid.textContent = '';
      CORE_LABELS.forEach(function (c) {
        var chip = el('a', 'trtt-pro-label-chip', c.label);
        chip.href = HOME + 'search/label/' + encodeURIComponent(c.label);
        chip.style.borderLeft = '3px solid ' + c.color;
        grid.appendChild(chip);
      });
    });
  }

  function upgradeFooter() {
    var footer = document.querySelector('.trtt-footer');
    if (!footer || document.getElementById('trtt-pro-footer-grid')) return;

    var shell = footer.querySelector('.trtt-shell') || footer;
    shell.textContent = '';

    var grid = el('div', 'trtt-pro-footer-grid');
    grid.id = 'trtt-pro-footer-grid';

    var col1 = el('div');
    col1.appendChild(el('h4', '', 'TRTT Voyage'));
    col1.appendChild(el('p', '', 'Sanluri to World - Independent flight intelligence, passenger rights guides, eSIM tips, and everyday travel stories from Sardinia, Italy.'));
    grid.appendChild(col1);

    var col2 = el('div');
    col2.appendChild(el('h4', '', 'Popular Labels'));
    var ul2 = el('ul', 'trtt-pro-footer-links');
    CORE_LABELS.slice(0, 5).forEach(function (item) {
      var li = el('li');
      var a = el('a', '', item.label);
      a.href = HOME + 'search/label/' + encodeURIComponent(item.label);
      li.appendChild(a);
      ul2.appendChild(li);
    });
    col2.appendChild(ul2);
    grid.appendChild(col2);

    var col3 = el('div');
    col3.appendChild(el('h4', '', 'Editorial & Transparency'));
    var ul3 = el('ul', 'trtt-pro-footer-links');
    [
      { text: 'Home - All Stories', href: HOME },
      { text: 'Sanluri Diary', href: HOME + 'search/label/' + encodeURIComponent('Sanluri Diary') },
      { text: 'AI Playground', href: HOME + 'search/label/' + encodeURIComponent('AI Playground') }
    ].forEach(function (item) {
      var li = el('li');
      var a = el('a', '', item.text);
      a.href = item.href;
      li.appendChild(a);
      ul3.appendChild(li);
    });
    col3.appendChild(ul3);
    grid.appendChild(col3);

    var bottom = el('div', 'trtt-pro-footer-bottom');
    bottom.appendChild(el('span', '', 'TRTT News 24 BD - By Abu Taher - Marker ' + MARKER + ' Active'));
    bottom.appendChild(el('span', '', 'Disclosure: Partner links may earn commission at no extra cost to you.'));

    shell.appendChild(grid);
    shell.appendChild(bottom);
  }

  function setupBackToTop() {
    if (document.getElementById('trtt-top-btn')) return;
    var btn = el('button');
    btn.id = 'trtt-top-btn';
    btn.type = 'button';
    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Back to top');
    btn.appendChild(makeIcon('up', 20));
    btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
    });
    document.body.appendChild(btn);

    window.addEventListener('scroll', function () {
      btn.classList.toggle('is-visible', window.scrollY > 320);
    }, { passive: true });
  }

  function run() {
    injectFontsAndCSS();
    setupTopStripAndLogo();
    setupCategoryNav();
    renderLabelBadgesInPosts();
    enhanceSinglePost();
    loadLiveLabelsDirectory();
    upgradeFooter();
    setupBackToTop();
  }

  window.addEventListener('load', function () {
    if (document.getElementById('tu-bub') || document.getElementById('trtt-menu-launch')) {
      document.body.classList.add('trtt-has-float');
    }
    renderLabelBadgesInPosts();
  });

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', run);
  } else {
    run();
  }
})();
